g.text: GPU: AMD Radeon 890M | NPU power snapshots: default (batch snapshots)
Bars: sample p10–p90. GPU events include scheduling/probe effects; NPU stages are CPU-host spans, not device compute cycles.
Compared frontend stages are summed within each invocation before aggregation; individual stages remain in CSV/JSON.
CPU/GPU clocks are not aligned. Independent medians are not additive. Diagnostics are separate from ordinary FFN timing.
